'''Sluis Van Orbital Dock V-475''' was a [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] [[Space Dock/Legends|Space Dock]] that was part of the [[Sluis Van Shipyards]]. It was the site of the beginning of the [[Battle of Sluis Van]] as the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Nartissteu]]'' exploded close to the station.
